svg.title: GPUI: a continuous path from input to pixels
svg.desc: An isometric rendering assembly with layered Rust state and optional GPUI Kit controls, GPUI layout and text, a glyph atlas and drawing scene, GPU batches, and a desktop window. Streams of input events travel along visible traces, through the processing layers and into an updating window. A platform service bus supplies input, windows and accessibility. Animation is illustrative, not a performance measurement.
svg.text: A shorter path from input to pixels
Rust state → GPUI layout & text → GPU drawing → updated window
Event streams are illustrative; animation speed is not a benchmark.
